retrievalProfile.description: A dense, warm-toned collage of vintage analog measuring tools and scientific instruments with bold, high-contrast sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: warm cluttered still life with bold type
excludeWhen: clean flat vector illustrations are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, layered still life featuring a variety of brass and steel measuring devices—including rulers, tape measures, barometers, and stopwatches—bathed in warm, directional light against a dark, textured background, topped with heavy white sans-serif display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal intersection of a red ruler and yellow tape measure
Circular repetition of various gauge faces and clock dials
High contrast between bright white typography and dark, moody background
Dense overlapping of metallic and wooden textures
coreInvariants: Presence of multiple analog measurement scales (inches, centimeters, degrees)
Warm, amber-tinted lighting with deep shadows
Heavyweight, geometric sans-serif display font for the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A dense cluster of instruments fills the entire frame, with a large sextant in the upper left and a compass in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white title in the upper right quadrant acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal red ruler from the center-left toward the upper-right title, then circles through the various round gauges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is 'horror vacui' style, with dark shadows filling the small gaps between objects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark brown and black shadows providing depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and gauge faces.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary red and yellow from the measuring tapes and rulers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between text and background; saturated warm tones in the wood and brass.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or neon colors
Stick to earth tones, brass, and primary accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and cases.

preserve: Bold weight of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the 1960s display type.
Provides the geometric circular counters seen in the 'e' and 'o'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense, warm-toned still life photograph of vintage analog instruments including a brass sextant, a red wooden ruler, a yellow tape measure, and several round glass-faced gauges and stopwatches. Use moody, directional lighting with deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold white geometric sans-serif title in the upper right corner. Below it, add three lines of smaller uppercase white sans-serif text, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the main title bold and white?
Are there multiple measuring instruments present?
Is the lighting warm and moody?

mustRedesign: Do not include specific brand names on the gauges
Do not replicate the specific 'josie' logo
Ensure the text content is generic or user-specified
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red ruler creates a strong diagonal.
Ensure the white text is not obscured by background highlights.
Verify that the instruments look mechanical and analog.
Confirm the color palette is dominated by browns, reds, and yellows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a cluttered still life of [Subject Category: Analog Tools] with [Lighting Style: Warm/Moody] and overlay [Typography Style: Bold Geometric Sans-Serif] in a [Composition Style: High-Density Collage].
